basic_info.description: First time on the market in 50 years. Nestled in the Mission Terrace neighborhood of San Francisco is this Marina Style barrel front home with old world charm and period details! This 3 bed / 2 bath home boast a formal living with custom brick fireplace and built in bookshelves, walk through double French doors into a formal dining room with built in hutch perfect for entertaining, butler's swing door into an eat-in kitchen with pantry cabinets. Other features include: coffered ceilings, hardwood floor throughout with custom inlay borders, period detail wood baseboards, door and window trim. Terrazzo stairs. 1 car garage with storage. Street level entry door into garage area. Blank canvas backyard ready for your customization. Minutes to Bart, Balboa Park and Swimming Pool, City College of SF, Whole Foods, US Post Office, schools, public transportation, freeway entrance, and the bustling Mission Street corridor of restaurants and shops.
